name: A-Buffer Visibility Pass
definition: A GPU fragment-stage algorithm that generates an approximate visibility function ṽ(xe, x) for each view ray by storing depth and visibility control points in an A-Buffer (2D texture array).
summary: The A-Buffer Visibility Pass is a GPU algorithm that generates an approximate visibility function by storing depth and visibility control points in a fixed-layer A-Buffer to efficiently represent volumetric occlusion.
